name: trampled hollow soil
description: Loose earth and old drag marks fill a shallow depression behind the stones.

name: ash-stained verge
description: Ash has settled over an old track. Footprints end where the ground began to split.

name: living fissure
description: The ground splits into a wet, moving crack. Use the firm islands or the passage behind the broken walls.

name: cooled breach scar
description: The former wound has hardened into a firm, dark seam. It can be crossed.
